title: Basic Banking Services Access Act of 1991
short_title: Basic Banking Services Access Act of 1991

committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

actions.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking.

latest_action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking.

summaries.text: Basic Banking Services Access Act of 1991 - Requires each depository institution to: (1) offer a basic financial services account to low- and moderate-income persons under prescribed guidelines which include specified minimal deposit, balance, and withdrawal requirements; and (2) post a conspicuous notice of the availability of such accounts to its customers. Prescribes administrative enforcement guidelines. Subjects a depository institution to civil liability for non-compliance with this Act.
